answer.reason: I could not produce verified energies: this session has no code-execution tool, and diagonalizing the octahedral d5 Tanabe–Sugano matrices (doublet and quartet blocks, with B = 806 and C = 3570 cm⁻¹) by hand at nine Dq/B points is too error-prone to report as numbers. The level scheme is known: the sextet ⁶A₁g is the ground state at all Dq/B, and the quartet and doublet irreps are ⁴A₁g, ⁴A₂g, 2×⁴Eg, 3×⁴T₁g, 3×⁴T₂g, plus the doublet levels from ²I, ²H, 2×²G, 2×²F, 3×²D, ²P and ²S. Re-running with a numerical diagonalization of the Racah/Tanabe–Sugano matrices is needed to get the E/B values and to save diagram.png; no image was saved, so the path and sha256 are null.
